This pathway ultimately leads to the target cell Raji. Similarly, vorinostat is associated with KB 3-1, a compound that targets another molecule, which also leads to Raji. These findings indicate that vorinostat may exert its effects on Raji cells through multiple distinct molecular pathways, possibly through different targets. The scores from the evidence suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, but the exact mechanisms and the role of each intermediate molecule remain to be fully elucidated. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the molecular interactions involved, emphasizing the need for further experimental validation.
